thesis: Mark Zuckerberg and Dr. Priscilla Chan argue that curing disease by the end of the century requires bridging the gap between ambitious biological goals and the lack of shared foundational tools, rather than simply funding individual grants. They propose accelerating scientific discovery by building frontier AI systems and infrastructure like virtual cell models to create a 'periodic table of elements' for biology, thereby enabling the broader scientific community to make faster progress against disease.
